people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city on the edge of the Arnon Valley.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
translations.bsb: So at that time we took possession of this land. To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley, and half the hill country of Gilead, along with its cities.
translations.kjv: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
translations.asv: And this land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites:
